blocks.text: During the second quarter the field team replaced 34 fiber patch panels across the northern ring. Downtime totalled eleven hours, split over four maintenance windows.
Customer impact was limited to two buildings on the Riverside campus. Affected tenants received credits according to the standard SLA schedule.
